_comment: The backend suite is fully green: 0 failing tests, 0 failing suites, 174 collected.
These numbers are now a floor, not a debt record. The ratchet fails the build
if a test starts failing, and also if totalTests drops -- a suite that stops
loading contributes zero tests, so its failures would otherwise disappear
rather than show up as failures.
If you add tests, raise totalTests to match.
